TextView.android:text: A quick view of protection available on this device
Local checks and authorized assessment helpers
API_KEY | MODEL per line, or just MODEL to reuse the primary key. Up to 5 profiles; safety blocks are not retried.
URL checks send URLs to Google. File reputation sends only the SHA-256 hash to VirusTotal; files stay on this device.
Auto-checks on launch. Pull from the right edge to open this panel.
Live device-wide download and upload rate. No extra permissions.
CALL GUARD: OFF | SMS GUARD: OFF | SMS HIDE: OFF
HIDE SPAM SMS needs notification access. It cancels spam alerts from your messaging app; the messages stay in your inbox.
Toggle off to stop blocking without removing permissions.
Automatically rejects calls and hides promo SMS from Hutch, Mobitel, Dialog, Airtel, or SLT. On by default.
Incoming calls from your blocklist or hidden numbers are rejected. Spam SMS alerts are hidden when notification access is granted; Android does not let third-party apps delete messages.
No public ban-check API exists. To check your own account, open the official WhatsApp app and read any account restriction notice. This check does not send your number to a third party.
